intro: Workdays move fast, and so should your chair. Our chairs offers mobility, support, and a cushioned back with a tapered edge—ensuring all-day comfort without slowing you down.

features.title: Premium aesthetics that speak your style
features.text: Experience refined elegance with premium pure leather on the seat and back, complemented by chrome and stainless steel finishes. Inspired by a wishbone structure, the T-shaped back spine provides both visual appeal and functional flexibility—like the open wings of a bird, offering strength and freedom in every sit.

features.title: Effortless functionality made for you
features.text: The self-adjusting mechanism automatically adapts to your body weight—no manual adjustments needed. With customizable options for seat height, depth, back height, armrest height, and tilt angle, you get a chair that fits you perfectly, no matter how you work.

features.title: Ergonomics designed with you in mind
features.text: Enjoy full back support that aligns with your body’s natural contours. The soft-edged, wide armrests adjust in height for the ideal typing posture while providing ample room for leg movement. It’s about making every posture comfortable and every moment productive.

features.title: Performance that lasts
features.text: Built to withstand daily use, this chair meets stringent BIFMA X-5.1 performance standards, ensuring you invest in comfort, durability, and peace of mind.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: La Sede High Back Leather Executive Chair
